note: §3/KS-3: an `event` refdecl list may be empty, may repeat a Kind, or may name something that is not a `group/version/Kind` path — all three are illegal at definition. This is the third: a member that is not a path names no Kind, so the check the declaration promises could never run.

spec.description: A Kind whose event refdecl names something that is not a Kind path.
